name: OrderGlass
description: OrderGlass exposes when two written configuration operations depend on execution order. GenLayer validators independently compile the complete operation/state table, agreeing on destinations, disabled inputs and unknown behavior. Deterministic code compares A→B and B→A from every declared state and preserves the exact counterexample paths. The browser displays both orders, checks source and proof integrity, and lets the owner record a certificate-bound rehearsal only for a commuting pair. Stable Studionet evidence covers ORDER_SENSITIVE, COMMUTES→REHEARSED and REVIEW, plus two finalized guard errors with unchanged records. Three records were independently read back. The model is finite and abstract: no external configuration is executed.
